AcceptEnv.description: Specifies what environment variables sent by the client will be copied into the session's environ(7).

AddressFamily.description: Specifies which address family should be used by sshd(8).

AllowAgentForwarding.description: Specifies whether ssh-agent(1) forwarding is permitted.

AllowGroups.description: Login allowed only for users whose primary group or supplementary group list matches one of the patterns.

AllowStreamLocalForwarding.description: Specifies whether StreamLocal (Unix-domain socket) forwarding is permitted.

AllowTcpForwarding.description: Specifies whether TCP forwarding is permitted.

AllowUsers.description: Login allowed only for user names that match one of the patterns.

AuthenticationMethods.description: Specifies the authentication methods that must be successfully completed for a user to be granted access.

AuthorizedKeysCommand.description: Specifies a program to be used to look up the user's public keys.

AuthorizedKeysCommandUser.description: Specifies the user under whose account the AuthorizedKeysCommand is run.

AuthorizedKeysFile.description: Specifies the file that contains the public keys used for user authentication.

AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand.description: Specifies a program to be used to generate the list of allowed certificate principals.

AuthorizedPrincipalsCommandUser.description: Specifies the user under whose account the AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand is run.

AuthorizedPrincipalsFile.description: Specifies a file that lists principal names accepted for certificate authentication.

Banner.description: The contents of the specified file are sent to the remote user before authentication is allowed.

CASignatureAlgorithms.description: Specifies which algorithms are allowed for signing of certificates by certificate authorities (CAs).

ChannelTimeout.description: Specifies whether and how quickly sshd(8) should close inactive channels.

ChrootDirectory.description: Specifies the pathname of a directory to chroot(2) to after authentication.

ClientAliveCountMax.description: Sets the number of client alive messages which may be sent without sshd(8) receiving any messages back from the client.

ClientAliveInterval.description: Sets a timeout interval in seconds after which if no data has been received from the client, sshd(8) will send a message through the encrypted channel to request a response from the client.

Compression.description: Specifies whether compression is enabled after the user has authenticated successfully.

DebianBanner.description: Specifies whether the distribution-specified extra version suffix is included during initial protocol handshake.

DenyGroups.description: Login is disallowed for users whose primary group or supplementary group list matches one of the patterns.

DenyUsers.description: Login is disallowed for user names that match one of the patterns.

DisableForwarding.description: Disables all forwarding features, including X11, ssh-agent(1), TCP and StreamLocal.

ExposeAuthInfo.description: Writes a temporary file containing a list of authentication methods and public credentials used to authenticate the user.

FingerprintHash.description: Specifies the hash algorithm used when logging key fingerprints.

ForceCommand.description: Forces the execution of the command specified by ForceCommand, ignoring any command supplied by the client.

GSSAPIAuthentication.description: Specifies whether user authentication based on GSSAPI is allowed.

GSSAPICleanupCredentials.description: Specifies whether to automatically destroy the user's credentials cache on logout.

GSSAPIKexAlgorithms.description: The list of key exchange algorithms that are accepted by GSSAPI key exchange.

GSSAPIKeyExchange.description: Specifies whether key exchange based on GSSAPI is allowed.

GSSAPIStoreCredentialsOnRekey.description: Controls whether the user's GSSAPI credentials should be updated following a successful connection rekeying.

GSSAPIStrictAcceptorCheck.description: Determines whether to be strict about the identity of the GSSAPI acceptor a client authenticates against.

GatewayPorts.description: Specifies whether remote hosts are allowed to connect to ports forwarded for the client.

HostCertificate.description: Specifies a file containing a public host certificate.

HostKey.description: Specifies a file containing a private host key used by SSH.

HostKeyAgent.description: Identifies the UNIX-domain socket used to communicate with an agent that has access to the private host keys.

HostKeyAlgorithms.description: Specifies the host key signature algorithms that the server offers.

HostbasedAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be accepted for hostbased authentication.

HostbasedAuthentication.description: Specifies whether rhosts or /etc/hosts.equiv authentication together with successful public key client host authentication is allowed.

HostbasedUsesNameFromPacketOnly.description: Specifies whether or not the server will attempt to perform a reverse name lookup when matching the name in the ~/.shosts, ~/.rhosts, and /etc/hosts.equiv files during HostbasedAuthentication.

IPQoS.default: lowdelay for interactive, throughput for non-interactive
IPQoS.description: Specifies the IPv4 type-of-service or DSCP class for the connection.

IgnoreRhosts.description: Specifies whether to ignore per-user .rhosts and .shosts files during HostbasedAuthentication.

IgnoreUserKnownHosts.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should ignore the user's ~/.ssh/known_hosts during HostbasedAuthentication.

KbdInteractiveAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to allow keyboard-interactive authentication.

KerberosAuthentication.description: Specifies whether the password provided by the user for PasswordAuthentication will be validated through the Kerberos KDC.

KerberosGetAFSToken.description: If AFS is active and the user has a Kerberos 5 TGT, attempt to acquire an AFS token before accessing the user's home directory.

KerberosOrLocalPasswd.description: If password authentication through Kerberos fails then the password will be validated via any additional local mechanism such as /etc/passwd.

KerberosTicketCleanup.description: Specifies whether to automatically destroy the user's ticket cache file on logout.

KexAlgorithms.description: Specifies the available KEX (Key Exchange) algorithms.

ListenAddress.description: Specifies the local addresses sshd(8) should listen on.

LogLevel.description: Gives the verbosity level that is used when logging messages from sshd(8).

LogVerbose.description: Specify one or more overrides to LogLevel.

LoginGraceTime.description: The server disconnects after this time if the user has not successfully logged in.

MACs.description: Specifies the available MAC (message authentication code) algorithms.

MaxAuthTries.description: Specifies the maximum number of authentication attempts permitted per connection.

MaxSessions.description: Specifies the maximum number of open shell, login or subsystem sessions permitted per network connection.

MaxStartups.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent unauthenticated connections to the SSH daemon.

ModuliFile.description: Specifies the moduli(5) file that contains the Diffie-Hellman groups used for key exchange methods.

PasswordAuthentication.description: Specifies whether password authentication is allowed.

PerSourceMaxStartups.description: Specifies the number of unauthenticated connections allowed from a given source address.

PerSourceNetBlockSize.description: Specifies the number of bits of source address that are grouped together for the purposes of applying PerSourceMaxStartups limits.

PermitEmptyPasswords.description: When password authentication is allowed, specifies whether the server allows login to accounts with empty password strings.

PermitListen.description: Specifies the addresses/ports on which a remote TCP port forwarding may listen.

PermitOpen.description: Specifies the destinations to which TCP port forwarding is permitted.

PermitRootLogin.description: Specifies whether root can log in using ssh(1).

PermitTTY.description: Specifies whether pty(4) allocation is permitted.

PermitTunnel.description: Specifies whether tun(4) device forwarding is allowed.

PermitUserEnvironment.description: Specifies whether ~/.ssh/environment and environment= options in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys are processed by sshd(8).

PermitUserRC.description: Specifies whether any ~/.ssh/rc file is executed.

PidFile.description: Specifies the file that contains the process ID of the SSH daemon.

Port.description: Specifies the port number that sshd(8) listens on.

PrintLastLog.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should print the date and time of the last user login when a user logs in interactively.

PrintMotd.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should print /etc/motd when a user logs in interactively.

PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be accepted for public key authentication.

PubkeyAuthOptions.description: Sets one or more public key authentication options.

PubkeyAuthentication.description: Specifies whether public key authentication is allowed.

RekeyLimit.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data that may be transmitted or received before the session key is renegotiated.

RequiredRSASize.description: Specifies the minimum RSA key size (in bits) that sshd(8) will accept. Note that this limit may only be raised from the default.

RevokedKeys.description: Specifies revoked public keys file, or none to not use one.

SecurityKeyProvider.description: Specifies a path to a library that will be used when loading FIDO authenticator-hosted keys.

SetEnv.description: Specifies one or more environment variables to set in child sessions started by sshd(8).

StreamLocalBindMask.description: Sets the octal file creation mode mask (umask) used when creating a Unix-domain socket file for local or remote port forwarding.

StreamLocalBindUnlink.description: Specifies whether to remove an existing Unix-domain socket file for local or remote port forwarding before creating a new one.

StrictModes.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should check file modes and ownership of the user's files and home directory before accepting login.

Subsystem.description: Configures an external subsystem (e.g. file transfer daemon).

TCPKeepAlive.description: Specifies whether TCP keepalive messages will be sent to the client.

TrustedUserCAKeys.description: Specifies a file containing public keys of certificate authorities trusted for user authentication.

UnusedConnectionTimeout.description: Specifies whether and how quickly sshd(8) should close unused SSH connections.

UseDNS.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should look up the remote host name and check that the resolved host name for the remote IP address maps back to the very same IP address.

UsePAM.description: Specifies whether the AuthenticationMethods and PasswordAuthentication directives are handled by PAM.

X11DisplayOffset.description: Specifies the first display number available for sshd(8)'s X11 forwarding.

X11Forwarding.description: Specifies whether X11 forwarding is permitted.

X11UseLocalhost.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should bind the X11 forwarding server to the loopback address.

XAuthLocation.description: Specifies the full path to the xauth program.
